title: Krystal Versace wins UK Series 3
summary: In the Grand Finale (UK-S03-E10), Krystal Versace, Ella Vaday, and Kitty Scott-Claus lip-synced to Dusty Springfield's "You Don't Own Me". Krystal was crowned the winner — the youngest person to win a Drag Race season at the time. Ella and Kitty finished as runners-up. Early UK series offered no cash prize.

title: Anubis: UK Series 3 Porkchop
summary: Anubis was the first contestant eliminated on RuPaul's Drag Race UK Series 3 (UK-S03-E01), lip-syncing to Little Mix's "Sweet Melody" against Elektra Fence.

title: Victoria Scone withdraws after injury
summary: Victoria Scone, the franchise's first cisgender female contestant, was forced to withdraw in UK-S03-E03 after a knee injury sustained in Episode 1. She had been in the top two of the premiere before losing the lip sync for the win to Krystal Versace.

title: Double sashay after Snatch Game
summary: In UK-S03-E06, Choriza May and River Medway lip-synced to Lulu's "Shout" after Snatch Game. RuPaul eliminated both queens, a double sashay that left Ella Vaday as the challenge winner.

title: Veronica Green returns after Series 2 exit
summary: Veronica Green, who had been forced to withdraw from UK Series 2 after testing positive for COVID-19, returned with an open invitation for Series 3. She was eliminated in UK-S03-E03 after lip-syncing to "I've Got the Music in Me" against Vanity Milan.
